arxiv-2005-01865.title: JaxNet: Scalable Blockchain Network
arxiv-2005-01865.creator: Iurii Shyshatsky, Vinod Manoharan, Taras Emelyanenko, Lucas Leger
arxiv-2005-01865.description: Abstract Today’s world is organized based on merit and value. A single global currency that’s decentralized is needed for a global economy. Bitcoin is a partial solution to this need, however it suffers from scalability problems which prevent it from being mass-adopted.

arxiv-2012-07539.title: Effects of modal energy scattering and friction on the resonance mitigation with an impact absorber Journal: JSV
arxiv-2012-07539.creator: Timo Theurich, Johann Gross, Malte Krack
arxiv-2012-07539.description: Abstract A linear vibration absorber can be tuned to effectively suppress the resonance of a particular vibration mode. It relies on the targeted energy transfer into the absorber within a narrow and fixed frequency band. Nonlinear energy sinks (NES) have a similar working principle.

arxiv-2104-11011.title: Learning Neural Network Quantum States with the Linear Method
arxiv-2104-11011.creator: J. Thorben Frank, Michael J. Kastoryano
arxiv-2104-11011.description: Abstract Due to the strong correlations present in quantum systems, classical machine learning algorithms like stochastic gradient descent are often insufficient for the training of neural network quantum states (NQSs). These difficulties can be overcome by using physically inspired learning algorithm, the most prominent of which is the stochastic reconfiguration (SR) which mimics imaginary time evolution.

arxiv-2210-04138.title: Origin of negative electrocaloric effect in Pnma -type antiferroelectric perovskites
arxiv-2210-04138.creator: Ningbo Fan, Jorge Íñiguez, L. Bellaiche, Bin Xu
arxiv-2210-04138.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ningbo Fan, Jorge Íñiguez, L. Bellaiche, Bin Xu. Anomalous electrocaloric effect (ECE) with decreasing temperature upon application of an electric field is known to occur in antiferroelectrics (AFEs), and previous understanding refers to the field-induced canting of electric dipoles if there is no phase transitions. Here, we use a first-principle-based method to study the ECE in Nd-substituted BiFeO 3 (BNFO) perovskite solid solutions, which has the Pnma -type AFE ground state.

arxiv-2302-06613.title: Explainable artificial intelligence toward usable and trustworthy computer-aided diagnosis of multiple sclerosis from Optical Coherence Tomography Thanks: This work was partially supported by the national research grants PID2019-104358RB-I00 (DL-Ageing project), Government of Aragon Group Reference
arxiv-2302-06613.creator: Monica Hernandez, Ubaldo Ramon-Julvez, Elisa Vilades, Beatriz Cordon, Elvira Mayordomo, Elena Garcia-Martin
arxiv-2302-06613.description: Abstract Background: Several studies indicate that the anterior visual pathway provides information about the dynamics of axonal degeneration in Multiple Sclerosis (MS). Current research in the field is focused on the quest for the most discriminative features among patients and controls and the development of machine learning models that yield computer-aided solutions widely usable in clinical practice.

arxiv-2306-02305.title: Information-Theoretic Limits on Compression of Semantic Information 0*This work is partly supported by the SUTD-ZJU IDEA Grant (SUTD-ZJU (VP) 202102), and partly by the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities under Grant 2021FZZX001-20.
arxiv-2306-02305.creator: Jiancheng Tang, Qianqian Yang 2 , Zhaoyang Zhang
arxiv-2306-02305.description: Abstract As conventional communication systems based on classic information theory have closely approached the limits of Shannon channel capacity, semantic communication has been recognized as a key enabling technology for the further improvement of communication performance. However, it is still unsettled on how to represent semantic information and characterise the theoretical limits.

arxiv-2306-11855.title: A Model-free Closeness-of-influence Test for Features in Supervised Learning
arxiv-2306-11855.creator: Mohammad Mehrabi, Ryan A. Rossi
arxiv-2306-11855.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Mehrabi, Ryan A. Rossi. Understanding the effect of a feature vector x ∈ ℝ d x\in{\mathbb{R}}^{d} on the response value (label) y ∈ ℝ y\in{\mathbb{R}} is the cornerstone of many statistical learning problems. Ideally, it is desired to understand how a set of collected features combine together and influence the response value, but this problem is notoriously difficult, due to the high-dimensionality of data and limited number of labeled data points, among many others.

arxiv-2403-13129.title: Better Call SAL: Towards Learning to Segment Anything in Lidar
arxiv-2403-13129.creator: Aljoša Ošep 1* Tim Meinhardt 1* Francesco Ferroni 1 Neehar Peri 2, Deva Ramanan 2 Laura Leal-Taixé 1, * Equal contribution, https://github.com/nv-dvl/segment-anything-lidar
arxiv-2403-13129.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Aljoša Ošep 1* Tim Meinhardt 1* Francesco Ferroni 1 Neehar Peri 2, Deva Ramanan 2 Laura Leal-Taixé 1, * Equal contribution, https://github.com/nv-dvl/segment-anything-lidar. We propose the SAL ( S egment A nything in L idar) method consisting of a text-promptable zero-shot model for segmenting and classifying any object in Lidar, and a pseudo-labeling engine that facilitates model training without manual supervision.

arxiv-2403-16944.title: The Tarantula–Revealed by X-rays (T-ReX) Journal: ApJS Facilities: CXO (ACIS), Gaia, ESO:VISTA (VIRCAM), VLT:Kueyen (FLAMES-ARGUS), HST (WFC3, ACS), Spitzer (IRAC, MIPS), WISE Herschel (SPIRE) ACIS Extract ( Broos et al. 2010 ; Broos et al. 2012 ; Broos & Townsley 2016 ) , CIAO ( Fruscione et al. 20
arxiv-2403-16944.creator: Leisa K. Townsley, Patrick S. Broos, Matthew S. Povich
arxiv-2403-16944.description: Abstract The Tarantula Nebula (30 Doradus) is the most important star-forming complex in the Local Group, offering a microscope on starburst astrophysics. At its heart lies the exceptionally rich young stellar cluster R136, containing the most massive stars known. Stellar winds and supernovae have carved 30 Dor into an amazing display of arcs, pillars, and bubbles.

arxiv-2409-13365.title: Quantum Speed limit on the production of quantumness of observables
arxiv-2409-13365.creator: Divyansh Shrimali, Swapnil Bhowmick, Arun Kumar Pati
arxiv-2409-13365.description: Abstract Non-classical features of quantum systems can degrade when subjected to environment and noise. Here, we ask a fundamental question: What is the minimum amount of time it takes for a quantum system to exhibit non-classical features in the presence of noise?

pmc-11329516.title: Screening of differentially expressed RNAs and identifying a ceRNA axis during cadmium-induced oxidative damage in pancreatic β cells
pmc-11329516.creator: Yahao Mou, Yifei Sun, Guofen Liu, Nan Zhang, Zuoshun He, Shiyan Gu
pmc-11329516.description: Cadmium, a common metal pollutant, has been demonstrated to induce type 2 diabetes by disrupting pancreatic β cells function. In this study, transcriptome microarray was utilized to identify differential gene expression in oxidative damage to pancreatic β cells following cadmium exposure. The results indicated that a series of mRNAs, LncRNAs, and miRNAs were altered.

pmc-12471366.title: Hypothermic Machine Perfusion vs. Static Cold Storage in Kidney Transplantation: A Retrospective Paired-Kidney Study from Latvia
pmc-12471366.creator: Pāvils Plūme, Igors Losevs, Elizabete Anna Loseva, Aleksandrs Maļcevs, Vadims Suhorukovs, Olga Jegorova, Viktors Ševeļovs, Jānis Jušinskis, Michal Nowicki
pmc-12471366.description: Background and Objectives: Kidney transplantation remains the gold-standard treatment for end-stage renal disease (ESRD). For deceased donor transplantation, optimal allograft preservation represents a critical determinant of success. While static cold storage (SCS) has been the historical standard, hypothermic machine perfusion (HMP) has emerged in recent decades as a technologically advanced alternative.

pmc-12526303.title: Exploring the Impact and Mechanisms of Coffee and Its Active Ingredients on Depression, Anxiety, and Sleep Disorders
pmc-12526303.creator: Zijun Shi, Jin Luan, Yating Zhang, Guiping Wang, Can Mei, Linwanyue Chen, Weiji Zhou, Change Xiong, Tao Huang, Jianbo Zhan, Jing Cheng, Peter Pribis
pmc-12526303.description: Depression, anxiety, and accompanying sleep disorders are common mood disorders worldwide, significantly affecting individuals’ physical and mental well-being as well as their quality of life. Coffee is a widely consumed beverage rich in bioactive compounds, including caffeine, polyphenols, tannins, proteins, and minerals, and studies suggest that coffee and its bioactive constituents demonstrate potential benefits for mental health.

pmc-12617148.title: OA20887. Nature Rx: Co-Creating Scalable Health Solutions through Eco-Therapeutics and Community Action
pmc-12617148.creator: M Papadakaki, E Petelos, E Chrysikou, and the Nature Rx Consortium
pmc-12617148.description: Issue/ProblemEurope is witnessing a surge in mental health disorders, physical inactivity, and social disconnection—challenges intensified by the COVID-19 pandemic, rapid urbanization, and the emerging burden of digital fatigue. Despite growing evidence, nature-based therapies (NBTs) remain largely absent from mainstream health systems.

pmc-12731965.title: Acute Ischemic Stroke in Non-Arteritic Anterior Ischemic Optic Neuropathy
pmc-12731965.creator: Victor Wenzel, Leon Alexander Danyel, Sophia Meidinger, Eberhard Siebert, Theresia Knoche, Charlotte Pietrock
pmc-12731965.description: Background: Non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION) is a neuroophthalmological disorder characterized by impaired blood flow to the optic nerve head. There is uncertainty about whether, in some cases, NAION may be caused by proximal embolism of the posterior ciliary arteries. Diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (DWI-MRI) can provide evidence of concurrent cerebral infarction that may indicate a common embolic etiology.

pmc-12848308.title: Caspase 6 deficiency exacerbates inflammatory bowel disease via enterocyte necroptosis and bacterial translocation
pmc-12848308.creator: Qiong Liu, Jun He, Lixin Liu, Leping Yang, Xiaoyan Qi, Zuxing Wei, Xuyang Hou, Dekun Liu, Yimiao Cheng, Ganglei Liu, Yanwen Zheng, Kuijie Liu
pmc-12848308.description: Caspase 6 is a pivotal executioner caspase involved in cell death; however, its role in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) remains incompletely understood. Levels of cleaved caspase 6 were quantified in colonic tissues from IBD patients, and an IBD mouse model was established via DSS induction, incorporating both systemic (Casp6 KO) and IEC-specific knockout (Casp6 cKO) strategies.

pmc-13330664.title: From health literacy to capacity preservation: advancing the next step in midlife frailty prevention
pmc-13330664.creator: Sitti Johri Nasela, Zulfikar Peluw, Muhammad Taufan Umasugi
pmc-13330664.description: be commended for positioning midlife as a meaningful window for healthy ageing intervention, rather than treating frailty prevention as a concern confined to advanced age. Their programme is particularly valuable because it integrates intrinsic capacity (IC) preservation, self-care and caregiving competencies within a community-based educational model.

pmc-13374448.title: Risk of cancer induced by human papillomavirus in patients with immune-mediated inflammatory diseases: a nationwide matched cohort study
pmc-13374448.creator: Clothilde Gros, Tiphaine Goulenok, Jean-François Timsit, Karim Sacre, Arthur Mageau
pmc-13374448.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionWomen with immune-mediated inflammatory diseases (IMIDs) are at an increased risk of human papillomavirus (HPV)-related cervical cancer. Our study aimed to assess the risk of HPV-induced cervical, vaginal, vulvar, anal and penile cancer in patients with IMIDs.MethodsWe conducted a nationwide matched cohort study comparing patients with IMIDs with a control group using the French nationwide hospital medical information database between 2016 and 2023.

pmc-13620132.title: Super Enhancer RNAs Rewrite the Molecular Script of Complex Gene Regulation in the MDD Brain
pmc-13620132.creator: Yogesh Dwivedi, Bhaskar Roy
pmc-13620132.description: Chromatin conformational changes are key to gene regulation in the brain and have recently been shown to be regulated by super-enhancer RNAs (seRNAs). We examine the role of seRNAs in major depressive disorder (MDD) by profiling the prefrontal cortex from 25 MDD subjects and 25 matched non-psychiatric controls.
